title: Receipt Pattern — Agent Skill
summary: The Receipt Pattern skill defines a standardized way for agents to log side‑effect actions (file writes, API mutations, deployments, etc.) into immutable JSON receipts. It includes when to write a receipt, a detailed schema, practical rules, and ready‑to‑use TypeScript and Python helper functions.
source_excerpt: # Receipt Pattern — Agent Skill You MUST write a receipt after every session that includes significant actions. ## When to Write a Receipt Write a receipt when your session includes ANY of: - File writes, deletions, or renames - API calls that mutate state (POST, PUT, DELETE, PATCH) - Database writes or schema changes - Sending emails, messages, or notifications - Deployments or infrastructure changes - Shell commands with side effects Do NOT write receipts for read-only operations (file reads, GET requests, db queries, linting, grepping). ## Receipt Location ``` receipts/YYYY-MM-DD-HH-MM-SS-[action-type].json ``` Example: `receipts/2026-03-05-14-35-22-file-write.json` Use the primary action type.
